representative_papers.title: Reconstructing Training Data from Adapter-based Federated Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Adapter-based federated LLMs assumed privacy-safe but vulnerable to gradient inversion attacks
representative_papers.approach: Token presence inference from attention, sentence-level inversion in low-rank space, semantic coherence via constrained greedy decoding
representative_papers.contribution: UTR attack reconstructs training text near-perfectly from adapter gradients even with large batches

representative_papers.title: PLIKD: Prompt Learning with Instance-aware Knowledge Distillation for Web-scale Semantic Image Classification
representative_papers.problem: Prompt learning for web-scale image classification overfits base classes and fails under distribution shift
representative_papers.approach: Instance-aware knowledge extraction from multimodal LLMs with dual-teacher knowledge distillation strategy
representative_papers.contribution: PLIKD improves generalization to unseen classes via external knowledge distillation

representative_papers.title: TraceLLM: Evaluating and Exploring Large Language Models on Trace Analysis in Microservice-based Web Applications
representative_papers.problem: Trace analysis in microservice systems requires high manual overhead and lacks flexible, deployable LLM approaches
representative_papers.approach: Fine-tuned LLM approach on TraceBench instruction-response benchmark for trace anomaly detection and diagnosis
representative_papers.contribution: TraceLLM improves trace analysis accuracy 34.77% over open-source LLMs via targeted fine-tuning

representative_papers.title: Towards Automated Brand-Safety Detection: A Novel Dataset and Comparative Analysis of Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Automated brand-safety detection lacks comprehensive datasets and evaluation
representative_papers.approach: Novel text dataset from narrative fiction with LLM and fine-tuned model comparison
representative_papers.contribution: First comprehensive brand-safety dataset; fine-tuned RoBERTa outperforms zero-shot LLMs

representative_papers.title: Social Bias Benchmarks for Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Social biases in multilingual LLMs across diverse languages and cultural contexts
representative_papers.approach: Systematic review of bias benchmarks across linguistic diversity and cultural awareness dimensions
representative_papers.contribution: Catalogue of bias evaluation methodological gaps, challenges and mitigation solutions in multilingual settings

representative_papers.title: Node Role-Guided LLMs for Dynamic Graph Clustering
representative_papers.problem: Dynamic graph clustering lacks interpretability and semantic explanations for cluster formation
representative_papers.approach: Node role prototypes with hierarchical LLM reasoning for discrete semantic concepts
representative_papers.contribution: Interpretable dynamic graph clustering with natural language explanations

representative_papers.title: Inference Cost Attacks for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: RAG-enhanced LLMs vulnerable to high inference costs through knowledge base poisoning
representative_papers.approach: Inject malicious documents into knowledge bases via LLM agents and reinforcement learning
representative_papers.contribution: CREEP framework with MA-GRPO algorithm for effective inference cost attacks on RAG systems

representative_papers.title: Toward Graph-Tokenizing Large Language Models with Reconstructive Graph Instruction Tuning
representative_papers.problem: Graph-Tokenizing LLMs achieve only implicit alignment; text-dominant bias underutilizes graph context.
representative_papers.approach: Reconstructive graph instruction tuning that reconstructs graph information from LLM outputs.
representative_papers.contribution: Explicit graph supervision improves alignment upper bound; better graph comprehension.

representative_papers.title: Large Language Models-Enhanced Semantic Diffusion for User-Centric Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Knowledge graphs lack user-side structural information due to scarcity and improper granularity for recommendations
representative_papers.approach: LLMs infer user interests; diffusion models generate contrastive views with semantic transitions
representative_papers.contribution: SEDIRec integrates user-side and item-side information via LLM-diffusion for sparse user recommendations

representative_papers.title: Swen: A Cross-Platform Desktop Assistant for Instant and Personalized Large-Language-Model Interaction
representative_papers.problem: Users must manually switch apps, copy-paste text, and craft prompts to interact with LLMs while reading
representative_papers.approach: Desktop assistant with intent recognition and evolving user profile for context-aware responses
representative_papers.contribution: Swen reduces knowledge lookup time by providing on-the-spot LLM assistance with automatic intent detection

representative_papers.title: LLMQuA: Practical Backdoor Injection on Large Language Model Quantization
representative_papers.problem: Backdoor attacks on quantized LLMs face data scarcity, layer-wise restrictions, and lack of gradient access
representative_papers.approach: Data-efficient knowledge editing with layer-local quantization parameter optimization and weight distortion
representative_papers.contribution: Achieves 67.91% moderation evasion and 90% targeted refusal with minimal model utility degradation

representative_papers.title: DHOW-MiLLA: Joint Workshop on Diffusion of Harmful Content on Online Web and Countering Misinformation in the Age of LLMs and Agents
representative_papers.problem: Harmful content analysis fragmented across platforms, languages, topics; limited cross-platform counter-measure study.
representative_papers.approach: Workshop unifying research on harmful content diffusion across platforms, languages, and content types.
representative_papers.contribution: Brings together misinformation, hate speech, cyberbullying research under one framework with LLM/agent focus.

representative_papers.title: SAGE: Sustainable Agent-Guided Expert-tuning for Culturally Attuned Translation in Low-Resource Southeast Asia
representative_papers.problem: Low-resource Southeast Asian languages lack data and energy-efficient translation methods
representative_papers.approach: RL agent curating compact training sets from expert dialogues, fine-tuning with LoRA on open LLMs
representative_papers.contribution: State-of-the-art translation for seven Southeast Asian languages prioritizing cultural relevance over scale

representative_papers.title: LLM-Powered Structurer: Normalizing Natural Language to Information Delivery Specification for Industrial Data Exchange
representative_papers.problem: Industry information standards XML-based formats difficult for non-expert users to adopt
representative_papers.approach: SGSS framework using LLMs to normalize natural language to Information Delivery Specification XML
representative_papers.contribution: LLM-driven accessibility bridge for industrial information exchange standards

representative_papers.title: Large Language Model for OWL Proofs
representative_papers.problem: LLMs' capacity to generate faithful proofs from OWL ontologies remains underexplored; complexity impacts performance
representative_papers.approach: Automated dataset construction and evaluation framework for proof extraction, simplification, and explanation
representative_papers.contribution: Study reveals logical complexity dominates performance; identifies gaps in resilient reasoning under imperfect conditions

representative_papers.title: Following the TRAIL: Predicting and Explaining Tomorrow's Hits with a Fine-Tuned LLM
representative_papers.problem: LLMs struggle extracting user preferences from sparse logs for real-time ranking
representative_papers.approach: Fine-tuned LLM with contrastive learning on trend signals
representative_papers.contribution: Joint prediction of popularity and faithful natural-language explanations

representative_papers.title: SemTech 2026: The 4th International Workshop on AI and Semantic Technologies for the Scientific, Technical, and Legal Web
representative_papers.problem: Scientific, technical, and legal web data are heterogeneous, semi-structured, with complex embedded entities
representative_papers.approach: Combine Semantic Web, NLP, and LLMs to process and reason over structured knowledge representations
representative_papers.contribution: SemTech workshop explores symbolic AI and LLM integration for robust, interpretable language models

representative_papers.title: PromptX: A Cognitive Agent Platform with Long-term Memory
representative_papers.problem: LLMs lack long-term memory and personalized reasoning for practical industrial agent applications
representative_papers.approach: Engram-based activation-diffusion memory networks with prompt markup language and HATEOAS orchestration
representative_papers.contribution: PromptX validated across 15+ enterprises with 50K+ downloads, demonstrating production feasibility

representative_papers.title: VC-Soup: Value-Consistency Guided Multi-Value Alignment for Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Multi-value alignment of LLMs faces expensive separate model training and substantial value conflict degradation
representative_papers.approach: Value-consistency guided data filtering and parameter merging framework leveraging linear mode connectivity
representative_papers.contribution: VC-Soup achieves favorable multi-value alignment trade-offs via value-consistent learning without expensive retraining

representative_papers.title: Unlocking the Multilingual Long-Tail Web: A Fused Macro-Micro Framework for Scalable Content Analysis
representative_papers.problem: LLMs struggle with long-tail language content analysis and robustness at scale
representative_papers.approach: Control-Tower Framework: micro-enhanced pretraining plus macro-optimized inference with MBR decoding
representative_papers.contribution: Improves long-tail language performance by +2.18 XCOMET-XXL

representative_papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Constrained Segmented User Modeling with Large Language Models for Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: LLMs for recommendation struggle with long sequences and hallucinate spurious preferences
representative_papers.approach: Reinforcement learning-constrained segmented modeling with cascaded preference inference
representative_papers.contribution: Rec2 suppresses hallucinations and aligns preferences using subsequent behavior as reward signal

representative_papers.title: SJBP: A Platform to Launch a Novel Jailbreak Attack on Large Language Models Based on Content's Spatial Distribution
representative_papers.problem: LLMs vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass existing safety defenses
representative_papers.approach: SpatialJB distributes harmful content across spatial dimensions to evade guardrails
representative_papers.contribution: Achieves 95% attack success on GPT-4 with 7x improvement over base64 jailbreak technique

representative_papers.title: Task-Aligned Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: MLLM unlearning with single objective causes unbalanced forgetting and quality degradation
representative_papers.approach: TAU framework optimizes multiple task-aligned objectives for classification, generation, and entity recall
representative_papers.contribution: Balanced unlearning across heterogeneous tasks while preserving non-target knowledge in MLLMs

representative_papers.title: Enhancing Large Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting via Vector-Injected In-Context Learning
representative_papers.problem: LLMs struggle with time-series forecasting due to domain mismatch between pretraining and TSF; fine-tuning adds computational overhead.
representative_papers.approach: Vector-injected in-context learning (LVICL) injects learnable context vectors into frozen LLM layers to extract and apply example information.
representative_papers.contribution: Improves LLM time-series forecasting performance without parameter fine-tuning, reducing computational overhead.

representative_papers.title: On-Device Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: LLMs for sequential recommendation lack efficient on-device deployment due to memory and computational overhead
representative_papers.approach: Task-adaptive compression via SVD low-rank decomposition and tokenization normalization with progressive alignment
representative_papers.contribution: OD-LLM enables efficient on-device LLM deployment for sequential recommendation without performance loss

representative_papers.title: Mitigating the Threshold Priming Effect in Large Language Model–Based Relevance Judgments via Personality Simulation
representative_papers.problem: LLMs susceptible to threshold priming in relevance labeling; personality effects unclear
representative_papers.approach: Big Five personality profiles simulated in LLMs to probe priming susceptibility
representative_papers.contribution: Personality prompting mitigates priming; High Openness and Low Neuroticism reduce bias

representative_papers.title: Question Answering Fit for Purpose: A Perspective From Natural Language Processing and User Modeling
representative_papers.problem: Question answering requires appropriate answers for complex information needs and intended audiences
representative_papers.approach: Integrating NLP, user modeling, and IR with LLMs for context-aware answer generation
representative_papers.contribution: Perspective on graceful human-machine interaction combining NLG, UM, and modern generative AI

representative_papers.title: NeuCon-ICE: Neuron-Level Controllable In-Context Editing for Multimodal Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Multimodal knowledge editing through in-context editing lacks controllability and relies on implicit contextualization without explicit guidance.
representative_papers.approach: Neuron-level controllable in-context editing identifying multimodal contextual neurons and selectively injecting context-aware updates.
representative_papers.contribution: NeuCon-ICE framework enabling controllable knowledge editing for MLLMs with neuron-level precision.

representative_papers.title: Formalized Information Needs Improve Large-Language-Model Relevance Judgments
representative_papers.problem: LLM relevance assessors using query-only setups reduce evaluation reliability and agreement
representative_papers.approach: Synthetically formalize information needs with LLMs into structured topics with descriptions
representative_papers.contribution: Formalized topics improve inter-assessor and human-LLM agreement in relevance evaluation

representative_papers.title: NeurPIU: Neurobiologically Inspired Personalized Intent Understanding in Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: LLMs fail on vague evolving queries, ignore user mental states in personalized intent understanding
representative_papers.approach: NeurPIU constructs intent neural network from brain mentalizing theory, uses spreading activation with temporal decay
representative_papers.contribution: Neurobiologically inspired framework enables personalized diverse responses via cognitive prefix injection

representative_papers.title: Verbalizing LightGCN: Direct Learning of Textual Representations from User-Item Interaction Graph via LLMs
representative_papers.problem: Traditional CF embeddings are opaque to pretrained LLMs; semantic and collaborative signals remain disconnected.
representative_papers.approach: VerbaLightGCN encodes collaborative signals as text and uses chain-of-thought prompting for LightGCN aggregation.
representative_papers.contribution: LLM-based recommendation unifying semantic understanding and collaborative signals in fully language-native form.

representative_papers.title: SciCheck: Reasoning Distillation for Biomedical Claim Verification
representative_papers.problem: Medical claim verification requires gold evidence during inference and expensive compute-intensive scaling.
representative_papers.approach: SciCheck combines web evidence retrieval with reasoning distillation from LLM traces filtered for correct answers.
representative_papers.contribution: Efficient biomedical claim verification outperforming proprietary LLMs with lower computational cost.

representative_papers.title: DLLM-Searcher: Adapting Diffusion Language Model for Efficient Search Agents
representative_papers.problem: Diffusion LLMs have latency and weak reasoning/tool-calling for search agents
representative_papers.approach: Agentic SFT and VRPO post-training with flexible parallel generation paradigm
representative_papers.contribution: Improves dLLM reasoning and tool-calling for efficient ReAct-based search agents

representative_papers.title: TM-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Low-Resource Traditional Mongolian
representative_papers.problem: LLMs lack systematic evaluation framework for Traditional Mongolian; performance severely limited on low-resource language
representative_papers.approach: TM-Bench hybrid construction via translation-based adaptation, expert authoring, and semi-automated synthesis
representative_papers.contribution: First comprehensive Traditional Mongolian benchmark with 18K instances across five tasks; reveals severe semantic collapse on generation

representative_papers.title: From Single- to Cross-Document: Benchmarking Multi-Granularity Event Analysis of Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: LLM event analysis lacks comprehensive evaluation across document granularity levels
representative_papers.approach: Multi-granularity benchmark with LLM-driven self-correcting annotation pipeline
representative_papers.contribution: MiGUE-Bench assesses LLMs on atomic to cross-document event tasks

representative_papers.title: Does LLM Relevance Labelling Work for Arabic?
representative_papers.problem: LLM relevance labeling effectiveness unexplored for Arabic and other non-English languages
representative_papers.approach: Evaluate LLM-generated Arabic relevance labels on system ordering and test collection
representative_papers.contribution: Shows LLMs viable for Arabic IR evaluation with caveats on high-performing manual systems

representative_papers.title: Attend to Fragments: How Key Information Affects Large Language Models for Factual Inconsistency Detection
representative_papers.problem: LLMs frequently fail to identify relevant information for factual inconsistency detection
representative_papers.approach: Benchmark KIFI annotating key information with token permutation identifying untrustworthy decisions
representative_papers.contribution: Token-based filtering improves inconsistency detection correlation by 1.3% on TRUE

representative_papers.title: Pretraining Exposure Explains Popularity Judgments in Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Popularity bias in LLMs unclear whether from real-world popularity or pretraining exposure statistics
representative_papers.approach: Direct large-scale analysis of OLMo models using complete Dolma corpus exposure statistics
representative_papers.contribution: Pretraining exposure strongly correlates with popularity; LLM judgments align more with exposure than Wikipedia

representative_papers.title: Efficient LLM Adaptation for Opinion Knowledge Graph Construction: Lessons from the Telecom Industry
representative_papers.problem: Adapting LLMs for structured opinion mining in telecom vertical, particularly for low-resource languages.
representative_papers.approach: Systematic study of instruction-tuning trade-offs, data efficiency strategies across LLaMA-3, Qwen, Mistral.
representative_papers.contribution: Counterintuitive findings on CPT benefits and data strategies for opinion knowledge graph construction.

representative_papers.title: Code-Based English Models Reveal Surprising Performance on Chinese QA Pair Extraction Task
representative_papers.problem: Automated QA extraction from unstructured text lacks efficiency and consistency across languages
representative_papers.approach: Code-based LLMs with expanded Chinese vocabulary for cross-lingual QA pair extraction
representative_papers.contribution: Code Llama-M outperforms Chinese-specialized models with lower hallucination on Chinese text
